versions.changelog:
flyai-elder-travel-care-core v1.0.0

- Initial release of the core entry skill for the Elderly Travel Butler, serving as the unified intent recognition and routing hub.
- Supports parent (elder) user scenarios with intent detection, skill routing, multi-intent handling, emergency prioritization, and context management.
- Integrates with itinerary, active companion, instant review, and AI video sub-skills.
- Language and dialect support (Mandarin, Sichuanese, Cantonese, Shanghainese, Northeastern dialects) with voice and large text modes for accessibility.
- Robust emergency response system with severity grading, error handling, fallback strategies, and user-friendly error prompts.
- Designed for elderly users with simplified steps, proactive care, and safety-focused interactions.
